sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (see Policy Schedule)

room_rent.note: Base policy has no room rent cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps at 1% of SI or ₹5,000/day (whichever lower) with proportionate deduction on other expenses.

icu.note: Base policy has no ICU cap. Optional 'Room Rent limit' add-on caps ICU at 2% of SI or ₹7,500/day (whichever lower).

copayment.note: Optional Co-Pay add-on allows insured to voluntarily opt 5%, 10% or 20% co-pay on every claim.

sub_limits.display: Cataract optional cap; domiciliary 10% of SI
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation capped at 10% of Basic SI inbuilt. Optional 'Cataract Capping' add-on (age 50+) caps cataract at ₹25k–₹40k per eye depending on SI. Modern surgeries covered under optional add-on at 50% of SI.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting is 36 months or 24 months as per plan in schedule. Optional 'PED Protector' add-on (age ≤50) reduces Diabetes & Hypertension waiting: Basic plan does not qualify for PED Protector (shown as NA in table).

specific_disease_waiting.note: Same tiered waiting periods as other variants: 12-month, 24-month, and 36-month lists as specified in policy wording.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Inbuilt Loyalty Perk: 10% of Basic SI per claim-free year, max 100%. Optional 'Super Booster' add-on increases to 50%/yr up to 150% of Basic SI.

restoration.note: Restored SI = 100% of Basic SI, triggered when Basic SI + Loyalty Perk exhausted. Cannot be used for same illness in current year. Optional 'Reload of Sum Insured' add-on waives same-illness restriction.

pre_hosp.note: Number of days not specified in wording.

post_hosp.note: Number of days not specified in wording.

domiciliary.note: Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH only; OPD/day care AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: Up to limit in Schedule; donor pre/post-hospitalisation excluded.

modern_treatments.note: Covered only via optional 'Modern Surgeries limit' add-on.

global_cover.note: Emergency inpatient care outside India; reimbursement in INR; max 180 days.

notable_exclusions: Maternity (excl. ectopic), STDs/HIV, dental (non-accidental), external congenital anomaly, OPD treatment, treatment outside India (unless Global Cover add-on), self-inflicted injury
optional_riders: Zero Deduct (consumables), Vector Borne Disease benefit, Super Booster (CB up to 150%), EMI Protector, PED Protector (N/A for Basic), Global Cover, Domestic Travel Plus, Reload of SI, Co-Pay, Modern Surgeries, Cataract Capping, Room Rent limit
